scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. A contract worker says his PAN was misused. Can the tax officer assess him on Form Twenty Six A S data alone?
scenes.shown: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. A contract worker says his PAN was misused. Can the tax officer assess him on Form 26AS data alone?

scenes.dialogue: On sixth October, a Delhi High Court Division Bench of Honourable Justice Dinesh Mehta and Honourable Doctor Justice Aditi Choudhary ruled.
scenes.shown: On 6 October, a Delhi High Court Division Bench of Honourable Justice Dinesh Mehta and Honourable Dr. Justice Aditi Choudhary ruled.

scenes.dialogue: In twenty twenty four, a contract security guard and cook got a tax notice. It alleged he paid a packaging firm nearly twenty five crore rupees in cash.
scenes.shown: In 2024, a contract security guard and cook got a tax notice. It alleged he paid a packaging firm nearly ₹25 crore in cash.

scenes.dialogue: He went to the police, denied the transactions, and asked for the material. It was not supplied. Then a demand of nearly four crore rupees was raised.
scenes.shown: He went to the police, denied the transactions, and asked for the material. It was not supplied. Then a demand of nearly ₹4 crore was raised.

scenes.dialogue: The Department said he should appeal first. But a stay normally needs a twenty percent deposit, about seventy eight lakh rupees, while interest keeps running.
scenes.shown: The Department said he should appeal first. But a stay normally needs a 20% deposit, about ₹78 lakh, while interest keeps running.

scenes.dialogue: The Court called that remedy illusory. And a demand causing avoidable mental anguish to a person of no means impinges on Article Twenty One.
scenes.shown: The Court called that remedy "illusory". And a demand causing avoidable mental anguish to a person of no means impinges on Article 21.

scenes.dialogue: Denying him the material breached natural justice. The order rested on Form Twenty Six A S data alone, with no independent inquiry.
scenes.shown: Denying him the material breached natural justice. The order rested on Form 26AS data alone, with no independent inquiry.

scenes.dialogue: Once he denied the transactions and rebutted the presumption, the burden was on the Assessing Officer. And the officer even counted the same money twice.
Either he did not understand the basics of accounting or he did not want to, said the Court. The order was quashed. Any fresh proceedings need cogent evidence.
